name: otta
description: The self-learning AI software factory. Turn agent coding sessions into acceptance-gated build, review, verification, and shipping workflows with lifecycle evidence for Otta Pulse.

interface.shortDescription: Build, verify, and ship software with evidence
interface.longDescription: Otta turns agent coding sessions into a traceable software delivery loop. Start from an issue and falsifiable acceptance criteria, build test-first, run specialist review and verification gates, and ship with lifecycle evidence that Otta Pulse can use to measure outcomes and improve future runs.
defaultPrompt: Set up Otta for this repository
Start the next issue with acceptance criteria and build it test-first
Verify this change and prepare it to ship
